name: flow
description: Flow — fast task management on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy:demo: pnpm build:demo && pnpm --filter @flow/api exec wrangler deploy --config ../../demo/wrangler.jsonc

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Signing in with it makes you the workspace owner. Set it under the Worker's **Settings → Variables** after the first deploy.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, like `your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`. Until it and `ACCESS_AUD` are set, Flow shows the setup steps instead of the app. See [the setup guide](https://github.com/joelborch/flow/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md#5-cloudflare-access).

ACCESS_AUD.description: The **Application Audience (AUD) tag** of the Access application protecting Flow's hostname: a 64-character hex string from Zero Trust → Access → Applications → Overview.

APP_HOSTNAME.description: The hostname Flow is served from, used in task links and webhook payloads: your `*.workers.dev` address or a custom domain.

EMAIL_DRY_RUN.description: Leave `"true"` (log instead of send) until Cloudflare Email Sending is set up for `EMAIL_FROM`.
